profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
- Years of experience in startup space as senior engineer, technical lead, and project manager 
- Experience building and managing teams: interviewing and hiring decisions, mentoring junior devs, reviewing code, implementing features, and meeting demanding deadlines
- Hobbyist game developer using Unity and Unreal Engine 

I believe the key to good tech is honest, hard work and the best teams support each other with open communication, cooperation, and humility.

I've built teams and products for multiple organizations and believe in sensible, simple, and scalable technical solutions. With experience working across a variety of budgets and organizations, I believe in being open-minded and versatile. 

Over the few decades, software has move toward higher-level abstractions, first in languages, but now in platforms. As someone that has worked with a huge variety of platforms such as WooCommerce, Shopify, Multiple CDPs and data pipelines, Klaviyo, and many more, I am well equipped to support or lead any engineering team.

----
Read more about my experiences at my website https://erickoyanagi.com or blog https://articles.erickoyanagi.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack engineer working on native application, rich web front ends, and PHP-based backend.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
- Work on projects in Laravel, Elixir, Node.JS (Express), Go, Vue, Nuxt, and C#
- Utilize AWS services like Lambda, Glue, Step Functions, S3, CloudFront, and more
- SageMaker for simple AI image detection implementation proof of concept (labeling data, training data, tuning model, deploying model)
- Implement RAG using langchain's HTML text splitter

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
A part of M&C Saatchi Consulting.

- Owned complex projects for large enterprise clients
- Authored technical audits to help win new business
- Worked directly with clients and stakeholders to implement software in PHP, JavaScript, React, and Python

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Led remote team in engineering across the stack, including daily scrums and code review
- Led development across mature, complex stack -- including WooCommerce, Symfony, and React
- Implemented features including fixing long-standing bugs, improving performance, and integrating new services
- Maintained site during high traffic periods, executed deployments and rollbacks

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Built strong, remote dev team working on a lean javascript stack 
- Led engineering team of nine developers from across the world 
- Implemented code reviews, mentored junior devs, and maintained wiki-based docs
- Managed projects, including writing specs, setting deadlines, and QA 
- Implemented features and fixed bugs in PHP, Node, Vue, and React Native. Implemented CI pipelines
- Worked closely with stakeholders to refine design, businesses logic, and plan sprints

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Led development of e-commerce system
- Migrated core systems to Shopify / Shopify Plus
- Implemented complex partners system in Laravel (PHP) to track commissions for gyms and schools
- Engineered data analytics pipeline using Treasure Data as a CDP and python/prestoSQL
- Worked with stakeholders to support Klaviyo and Salesforce
- Maintained and expanded peripheral sites in wordpress/woocommerce 
- Supported small dev team by creating CI pipelines, mentoring Jr. developers, and leading project management

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implement a variety of front end tests and designs
- Engineer and implement backend systems for analytics and content management
- Server optimization and monitoring
- DevOps work to transition from simple, FTP-managed code to continuous integration pipelines

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Developed game in C#
- Developed behavior trees for AI and branching dialog
- Created and optimized editor-based workflows for other team members to create/edit content 
- Refine and optimize game algorithms (object pooling, shader/lighting optimizations, concurrency)
- Created and cultivated social media following (Twitter, instagram, Facebook, imgur)
- Successfully launched and passed Steam's Greenlight program
- Launched on itch.io game market

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead developer for high-traffic Drupal-powered content site
- Implemented features in both PHP (web) and C# (desktop) for stand-alone backup application
- Optimized large mySQL data sets used for ad analytics
- Led Ruby on Rails development to create customer-facing analytics portals 
- Worked on mobile ad SDKs (Android and iOS) written in Java and Objective C
- Used agile methodologies and discussed specifications with stakeholders

positions.title: Web Development
positions.description:
- Created custom digital workflow to automate production, tracking, and shipping for manufacturer
- Created automated ERP-style software in manage production state and analytics
- Developed C# application to inject a barcode directly into the print process and quickly scan unique codes to track order progress
- Integrated with Costco photo center API to efficiently consume large quantities of image data and feed orders directly to print
- Worked onsite with stakeholders to integrate digital workflow with manufacturing line

positions.title: Junior Programmer / Intern
positions.description: Starting as an intern in my senior year of high school, I wrote a complex macro for excel that extracted data from an access database and applied a slick formatting to make data more readable, including generating graphs and neatly formatted tables. Transitioned to a paid position until project completion.
